title: The refinance horizon
hook: Two stated cases: explore the horizon needed to recover a switching cost.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the horizon needed to recover a switching cost affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saving, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the horizon needed to recover a switching cost in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
